all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Weald

all.name: Pilow

all.name: Knell
all.note: Knell (Major): Only an explicitly supplied active-stack snapshot is modeled; omitted state receives no shred credit. matchups.gameplan: Whenever this lane is not even, the winnable fight is yours: play aggressive, but respect jungle attention. Renna's main threat is Mortal Coil; bait it before you commit, and mixed resist softens the trade.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Raiment of Renewal instead of Tainted Scepter: their burst combo hits 16% less hard, and this kit gives up 13% of its damage for it.

matchups.gameplan: Whenever this lane is not even, the winnable fight is yours: play aggressive, but respect jungle attention. Lt. Belica executes low targets with Neural Disruptor — don't linger below half HP.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Raiment of Renewal instead of Tainted Scepter: their burst combo hits 17% less hard, and this kit gives up 13% of its damage for it.

matchups.gameplan: They out-threaten you whenever the lane is not even: treat this as a farm-and-team lane, not a duel. Gideon deals area damage — spread out so one cast can't catch the group.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Raiment of Renewal instead of Tainted Scepter: their burst combo hits 18% less hard, and this kit gives up 13% of its damage for it.
